senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. אָשַׁר)to be firm, strong, healthy; to be straight, right. יִישַׁר כֹּחֲךָ or חֵילְךָ ‘may thy strength (health) be firm’, a phrase of approval and thanks.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 87a:5">Sabb. 87ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. (play on <cite ref="A03347"><he>אֲשֶׁר</he></cite>, <cite ref="Exodus 34:1">Ex. XXXIV, 1</cite>) <he>י׳ כ׳ ששברת</he>, be thanked for having broken (the tablets).
Gen. R. s. 54 (play on וישרנה, I Sam. VI, 12) י׳ חילכם; a. e.—(יֵשַׁר) יִישַׁר (sub. כחך) thanks! right! Ber. 42ᵇ; Sabb. 53ᵃ; Erub. 32ᵇ; a. fr.—Cmp. אַיְשַׁר.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:17">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> (ref. to <he>יֵשֶׁר</he>, <cite ref="I Chronicles 2:18">I Chr. II, 18</cite>) <he>זה כלב שיי׳ את עצמו</he> that is Caleb who kept himself straight (did not yield to the rest of the spies).

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 8">Num. R. s. 8</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 50:23">Ps. L, 23</cite> <he>ושם דרך</he>) <he>המְיַישֵּׁר אורחותיו וכ׳</he> he who directs his ways straight (pays regard to his doings).—Part. pass. <cite ref="M01105"><he>מְיוּשָּׁר</he></cite>, f. <he>מְיוּשֶּׁרֶת</he>.
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 10:1">Pirké d’R. El. ch. X</cite> <he>דרכי מי׳ לפני</he> my way is levelled before me.—
<cite ref="Megillah 18b:14">Meg. 18ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>יישרו</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 4:25">Prov. IV, 25</cite>) <he>מְיוּשָּׁרִין הן אצל וכ׳</he> they remain firm with (in the memory of) &c.
